description:
S10 E02 — The One Where Ross Is Fine
Ross drinks too much alcohol at dinner with Rachel, Joey and Charlie; Frank Jr. (Giovanni Ribisi) cannot cope with his precocious triplets.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E03 — The One With Ross's Tan
Rachel and Joey nervously anticipate their first real date; Monica and Phoebe try to avoid an obnoxious friend with a fake British accent; Ross emerges from a tanning booth with a two-toned appearance.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E04 — The One With the Cake
Rachel gets Monica and Chandler to delay their trip to Vermont for Emma's first birthday bash.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E05 — The One Where Rachel's Sister Baby-Sits
Rachel feels like her younger sister, Amy, is finally on the verge of making a major change in her attitude; in order to help Amy become a more responsible person, Rachel overrides Ross' strong protests and allows Amy to baby-sit Emma.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E06 — The One With Ross's Grant
When Ross interviews with Charlie's ex-boyfriend (Greg Kinnear) for a prized grant, the doctor makes a shocking stipulation; Chandler lies about watching Joey's bizarre audition tape.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E07 — The One With the Home Study
Monica and Chandler fuss over their apartment as they expect a visit from the adoption worker, Laura; Phoebe and Mike opt for a small wedding and donate the extra money to a children's charity.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E08 — The One With the Late Thanksgiving
Monica prepares a Thanksgiving feast for the gang, then becomes enraged when everyone shows up late; Phoebe convinces Rachel to enter Emma in a baby beauty contest.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E09 — The One With the Birth Mother
A prospective birth mother (Anna Faris) labors under a misconception about Monica and Chandler's respective occupations.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E10 — The One Where Chandler Gets Caught
Rachel and Phoebe spot Chandler getting into a car with a mystery blonde; the friends reminisce about memorable moments.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E11 — The One Where the Stripper Cries
Joey appears as a celebrity contestant on "$100,000 Pyramid"; Monica and Rachel hire an ungainly stripper for Phoebe's bachelorette party.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E12 — The One With Phoebe's Wedding
A blizzard causes Phoebe and Mike's wedding to spiral out of control; uptight Monica steps in as her friend's wedding planner, then drives everyone crazy.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E13 — The One Where Joey Speaks French
Monica and Chandler show Erica the tourist sights; they learn their baby's biological father might be an unsavory character; Joey begs Phoebe to teach him how to speak French before an audition.

title: Friends
description:
S10 E14 — The One With Princess Consuela
Rachel goes to a job interview at a restaurant and winds up sitting next to her current boss; Joey feels abandoned because Monica and Chandler are leaving.

description:
S01 E09 — The One Where Underdog Gets Away
Monica and Ross cook Thanksgiving dinner for themselves, but everyone else shows up.

title: Friends
description:
S02 E08 — The One With the List
Rachel sees Ross' list comparing her pros and cons to Julie's (Lauren Tom).

title: Friends
description:
S03 E09 — The One With the Football
Emotions become the feast of the day when the gang plays a game of touch football on Thanksgiving; the turkey is left stewing when the losing team calls for a rematch.

title: Friends
description:
S04 E08 — The One With Chandler in a Box
To atone for kissing Joey's girlfriend, Chandler agrees to stay inside a shipping crate during the Thanksgiving holiday.

title: Friends
description:
S05 E08 — The One With the Thanksgiving Flashbacks
As the gang digests Monica's huge Thanksgiving meal, everyone reminisces about their worst Thanksgiving ever.

title: Friends
description:
S05 E09 — The One With Ross' Sandwich
Ross becomes upset when someone at work takes his sandwich from the refrigerator and eats it; Joey finds himself in a mess when he tries to cover for Chandler and Monica's dating.

title: Friends
description:
S06 E09 — The One Where Ross Got High
Chandler finds out Monica never told her parents he was living with her; Rachel tries her hand at making dessert.
